alert.summary: In-service instances of the web Auto Scaling group below 4

logs: ALARM AWS/AutoScaling/GroupInServiceInstances AutoScalingGroupName=warden-dev-web-asg stat=Minimum period=60s threshold LessThanThreshold 4.0 datapoints=2/2 missing=missing state=ALARM
STATE asg warden-dev-web-asg MinSize=3 MaxSize=12 DesiredCapacity=3 Instances=3(Healthy:3) SuspendedProcesses=0
CHANGE 2026-10-10T05:10:22Z autoscaling.amazonaws.com PutScheduledUpdateGroupAction on warden-dev-web-asg by role/warden-dev-terraform
context.alert_text: In-service instances of the web Auto Scaling group below 4

root_cause.hypothesis: A scheduled autoscaling action (PutScheduledUpdateGroupAction) reduced warden-dev-web-asg's desired/min capacity to 3, which is now below the alarm's static LessThanThreshold of 4.0 in-service instances, so the alarm fires even though the ASG is fully healthy at its new target size (3/3 healthy, no pending/terminating).
evidence: C1 shows the alarm compares GroupInServiceInstances against a fixed threshold of 4.0
C2 shows the ASG currently at MinSize=3/DesiredCapacity=3/Instances=3(Healthy:3), i.e. fully healthy at its configured size
C3 shows a scheduled capacity change was applied to this exact ASG shortly before
ruled_out: Instance failure or unhealthy hosts — C2 shows all 3 instances Healthy, no pending/terminating activity on this ASG

proposal.reasoning: The named ASG is healthy but its in-service instance count (3) is below the alarm's static threshold (4.0), likely because a scheduled scaling action intentionally lowered capacity without the alarm threshold being updated. Temporarily restoring desired capacity to at least 4 will clear the alarm condition while a human reconciles the alarm threshold with the new intended capacity; this does not touch the separate 'sibling' ASG referenced in the M metrics, whose relevance is unclear from this evidence.
proposal.expected_effect: GroupInServiceInstances rises to or above 4, clearing the ALARM state for warden-dev-web-asg-in-service.

reasons: The diagnosis is not grounded in the evidence: C2: 'MinSize=3, MaxSize=12, DesiredCapacity=3, Instances=3(Healthy:3)' does not appear in that item.
